sources.title: Rounds No Commentary Gameplay

sources.notes: Frame analysis used a 640x360 29.97 fps preview because the current media server rejected complete 60 fps downloads; timings therefore resolve to about two simulation ticks.

sources.title: Rounds

sources.title: Moveset
sources.scope: Default ammunition, approximate damage, jump storage, block behavior, and wall-adjacent shield bounce.

sources.title: All Cards
sources.scope: A 67-row vanilla card index with display names, rarities, visible behavior, and current displayed modifiers.
sources.notes: The ordinary reader returned HTTP 402, so the project's read-only fetch-url fallback recovered the public table. Descriptive prose and card art were not copied into the repository.

sources.title: All cards and linked card pages
sources.scope: An independently maintained vanilla index and 66 linked per-card pages, last updated in 2024-2025, used to cross-check names, visible behavior, and modifiers.
sources.notes: The index omits Quick Shot and contains several English-name typos. Those discrepancies are retained in the reconciliation record rather than silently normalized as source facts.

sources.title: ROUNDS Card List
sources.scope: A June 2024 vanilla list organized by rarity with visible card behavior and displayed modifiers.
sources.notes: Used as corroboration only. Conflicting modifiers remain explicit and the post-1.05 value wins only when supported by another current index or official note.

sources.title: ROUNDS basic guide
sources.scope: A complete October 2021 card guide used to confirm Quick Shot and preserve pre-patch modifier conflicts.
sources.notes: Several values predate or conflict with later public indexes; it is never the sole basis for a current numeric value.

sources.title: Does anyone know if the cards stack?
sources.scope: Contemporaneous player reports about repeated numerical, idempotent, duration, radius, and hook card behavior.
sources.notes: Reports disagree on several hook-heavy cards, so all inferred formulas except the integer bounce-count case remain provisional.
